title: Predictive Analytics in Finance: How Deep Learning Enhances Stress Testing
content: This paper explores the role of deep learning in enhancing stress testing within the financial sector. Stress testing is a critical risk management tool used by financial institutions to assess resilience under adverse conditions. Traditional methods rely on statistical models and historical data but often struggle with complex, nonlinear relationships in financial markets. Deep learning, with its ability to process vast amounts of unstructured data and identify hidden patterns, offers a more robust approach to predictive analytics. This study examines key deep learning techniques, including recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and transformers, that improve scenario analysis, risk forecasting, and decision-making. It also discusses challenges such as model interpretability, data quality, and regulatory compliance. By leveraging deep learning for stress testing, financial institutions can enhance predictive accuracy, mitigate risks more effectively, and strengthen overall financial stability.
